critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js: 4 TabsContent entries for EquipmentAdmin (equipment/accessories/formwork/warehouse) each wrap EquipmentAdmin in its own Suspense. Because EquipmentAdmin is lazy and each instance has different `category` prop, switching between Elektronarzędzia/Akcesoria/Szalunki will briefly show TabSpinner on first visit per tab (expected behavior, but note the chunk is shared so spinner only appears on first tab click after page load).

ToolsTab.js (530 lines): file is already near the 700-line soft limit. If more tools are added in future, consider splitting 'Synchronizacja Excel', 'Raport PDF', 'Linki publiczne', and 'Cron' into separate sub-components.

EquipmentModals.js: HistoryModal reads `historyForModal` prop (array) but does not receive a setter - okay since it's read-only. However the `historyForModal` is recomputed in EquipmentAdmin.js on every render; consider useMemo wrapping to avoid re-sorting history on unrelated state changes.

Login form (unchanged): occasionally page.fill() does not persist value in the admin-email-input before submit (observed in 2/3 UI runs in this iteration). Pre-existing - not caused by this refactor. Using page.click + page.keyboard.type works reliably.
